TEST FIXTURE. Obviously fictional organisations in the shape of the OFAC SDN legacy CSV exports
(SDN.CSV / ALT.CSV / ADD.CSV, Sanctions List Service, as recorded 2026-10-08): no header, -0- nulls
with trailing blanks, CRLF line ends and a trailing 0x1A; SDN_2.CSV is cp1252-encoded.
Publication 1 is the baseline (4 organisations, one individual, one vessel); publication 2 adds
9007 EXAMPLE SHELL FABRICS COMPANY LIMITED and 9008 SOCIETE EXEMPLE SARL, adds an alias to 9002 and
removes 9006. None of these names belongs to a real listed entity.
